title: Twist maximal-order seeds: complete cold IC/PDP cost after construction repair
status_note: Concrete follow-up proposal after verified generator-order/construction evidence. Not implemented or run; no protocol/source freeze or resource estimate. No funding/lease/allocation. Existing full-campaign criteria are unchanged.
blocked_on: note:Implement native instruments, independent certificate/replay, measured sizing and pre-data protocol before readiness.
question: Does a target-blind maximal-order twist seed reduce complete useful-relation or one-target IC cost after discovery and all failures are priced?
decision_value: A verified lower complete cost on fixed original tasks supports a scoped engineering gain; more filled or different bases alone do not. If discovery outweighs the extra eligible bases, retain the ordinary baseline; a verified reduction justifies separately frozen larger-field replication.

resources.notes: All ten original fixtures, B8/B16 and shifts1/3; fixed public development target labels only. Compare corrected seed, archived first seed, ordinary curve/AP/uniform controls. Retain unsupported and capped cells. Same-base group MITM/PDP controls must return identical complete rows; different bases require full cold useful-row/rank/recovery accounting. Charge all cardinality/order/seed searches, including the416 tests on the p827 noncyclic case, conversion, roots/signs, matrix work and source verification. Include matched A/A, planted/negative controls, strongest external full-root tool and matched rho. Freeze interleaving, masking, units and selection before data; no E28 final labels. Pilot limits must be estimated before readiness; proposed4GiB and bounded native cells are not an allocation. Full estimates remain missing; nominal resource fields do not authorize a launch.

outputs.result_schema: Proposed only. Independent replay of every output and useful-row rank; complete cold cost in one admitted unit on identical one-target tasks, strictly below the best frozen verified IC baseline. Compare matched rho and0/0.1/1 GAE bands where required; no claim of beating rho without its full gate. A construction-only difference or missing discovery cost fails acceptance.
